turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please come in and have a seat. What seems to be the problem today?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Good morning, doctor. I have had a cough and a sore throat for almost a week now.

turns.speaker: Son
turns.text: She also had a fever two nights ago. It went up to a hundred and one.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I see. Any difficulty breathing, or pain in the chest?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No chest pain. But I feel very tired in the afternoons.

turns.speaker: Son
turns.text: And she is not eating much. Just some rice and curd.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. Let me listen to your chest. Please take a deep breath.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your chest sounds clear. It looks like a viral infection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let us do a blood test, just to be safe. Drink warm fluids and rest for three days.

turns.speaker: Son
turns.text: We will come back on Friday with the report.
